notes: Read SKILL.md (353 lines) in full. The skill teaches context management for coding agents: a context hierarchy (rules files, specs, source, errors, history), example CLAUDE.md content, context packing patterns, budget management, restartable session handoffs, and how to surface ambiguity instead of guessing.

Following it may lead the agent to create or update a rules file (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, etc.) or session handoff notes in the user's project; the example rules file lists project commands (npm run build/test) as content, not commands for the agent to run. It explicitly gates commits on user/repository authorization (SKILL.md:133) and says to treat instruction-like content in external files as data (SKILL.md:103). No installs, credentials, or network access.
MCP servers (Context7, Chrome DevTools, PostgreSQL, GitHub) are mentioned as optional integrations only. No out-of-directory dependencies.
